description: Get the full record of one detection by id: technical characteristics (surface, kwp, tilt, azimuth — model estimates), imagery years, sources decoded into plain labels, frpv_proba, false-positive flag, rnb_id and location codes, plus simple confidence signals. Data quality note: this is a detection dataset, not an exhaustive inventory (estimated recall ~0.6). A missing detection does not mean no PV installation exists there. kwp, surface, tilt and azimuth are model estimates, not surveyed values. In this server, quality_filter=true keeps only detections identified by 2 or more sources (see source_encoding in get_data_quality_reference). Call get_data_quality_reference for the full picture before assessing fitness for a specific use case.

id.description: Registry identifier of the detection (the `id` field).

name: get_detection_details
